Name: Nyapu Styled Portraits for Darcy
Author: Blossom5280
Description:
[center]I downloaded Darcy's Coffee Shop by chocolatte12 but the portraits didn't match the ones im using!

So i had 2 options:

[b]A. Ignore the visual incompatibility[/b]

Or

[b]B. Make portraits that are compatible[/b]

As you see I chose option b :3

[u][i]Requirements:[/i][/u]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]﻿
&

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39520]Darcy's Coffee Shop n it's requirements[/url]﻿
﻿
[u][i]Installation Instructions:[/i][/u]

1. Download to your mod Folder along with Darcy's Coffee shop

2. Profit

[i][u]Uninstallation Instructions:[/u][/i]

1.Simply Delete the mod from your mod folder
